supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Represent and compare fractions in a way that makes sense to them.
teachingSteps: Ensure both fractions refer to the same-sized whole.
Use equal partitions or a number line to compare size.
Write <, > or = and explain why the difference in numerator or denominator matters.
